errors.evidence: The left vertical axis representing 'брой' (number) has a range from 0 to 200,000, not 300,000.
The description completely omits the second vertical axis on the right, which is labeled 'относителен дял %' (relative share %) and ranges from 0% to 10%.

errors.text_span: Най-високата стълба, представляваща 2019 г., достига над 197 377
errors.evidence: The value for the highest bar (2019) is explicitly labeled as 214,129. Stating it is 'above 197,377' (the value for 2018) is imprecise and misleading.
The lowest bar corresponds to the year 2013 with a value of 134,758, not 139,134, which is the value for 2009.

errors.text_span: като се вижда ясно увеличение на броя през периода
errors.evidence: This clause interprets the data to identify a trend ('clear increase... over the period'), which is explicitly forbidden by the prompt.
The bars are not grouped. This is a combination chart with a single bar series and a line series.

errors.text_span: стълбите са маркирани с относителния дял на осигурените лица, изразен в проценти
errors.evidence: The percentage values are data labels for the black line chart ('относителен дял'), not the bars. The bars are labeled with absolute numbers ('брой').
The percentage values shown in the chart range from 5.2% (in 2013) to 7.7% (in 2019). The stated range of 6% to 7.78% is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Освен това, има визуално подчертаване чрез засенчване, което позволява лесното различаване на стълбовете.
errors.evidence: There is no visual emphasis or shading on any of the bars. All bars are a solid blue color.
